30ysp-ch5-p002-r01.sourceEnglish: "The dungeon Enrique built is in the underground waterway."
30ysp-ch5-p002-r01.simplifiedChinese: “恩里克建造的地下城就在地下水道里。”
30ysp-ch5-p002-r01.pinyin: “Ēnlǐkè jiànzào de dìxiàchéng jiù zài dìxià shuǐdào lǐ.”

30ysp-ch5-p002-r02.sourceEnglish: That was the only information I had,
30ysp-ch5-p002-r02.simplifiedChinese: 这就是我掌握的全部情报，
30ysp-ch5-p002-r02.pinyin: Zhè jiùshì wǒ zhǎngwò de quánbù qíngbào,

30ysp-ch5-p002-r05.sourceEnglish: In the Prizhenkaya's central garden stand monuments and statues.
30ysp-ch5-p002-r05.simplifiedChinese: 普里任卡亚的中央庭院里矗立着纪念碑和雕像。
30ysp-ch5-p002-r05.pinyin: Pǔlǐrènkǎyà de zhōngyāng tíngyuàn lǐ chùlì zhe jìniànbēi hé diāoxiàng.

30ysp-ch5-p004-r01.sourceEnglish: ...was because Enrique was a member of the Hero's Party.
30ysp-ch5-p004-r01.simplifiedChinese: ……是因为恩里克是勇者小队的一员。
30ysp-ch5-p004-r01.pinyin: ...shì yīnwèi Ēnlǐkè shì yǒngzhě xiǎoduì de yīyuán.

30ysp-ch5-p004-r02.sourceEnglish: We are blades far too sharp to hold in an age of peace.
30ysp-ch5-p004-r02.simplifiedChinese: 我们是过于锋利的刀刃，和平年代无人能够握住。
30ysp-ch5-p004-r02.pinyin: Wǒmen shì guòyú fēnglì de dāorèn, hépíng niándài wúrén nénggòu wòzhù.

30ysp-ch5-p004-r06.sourceEnglish: Even when your names are forgotten,
30ysp-ch5-p004-r06.simplifiedChinese: 即使你们的名字被遗忘，
30ysp-ch5-p004-r06.pinyin: Jíshǐ nǐmen de míngzi bèi yíwàng,

30ysp-ch5-p004-r07.simplifiedChinese: 你们的荣光也将永垂不朽。
30ysp-ch5-p004-r07.pinyin: Nǐmen de róngguāng yě jiāng yǒngchuí bùxiǔ.

30ysp-ch5-p008-r02.sourceEnglish: One hundred years ago, she betrayed the elder vampire who had bitten her, drained his blood,
30ysp-ch5-p008-r02.simplifiedChinese: 一百年前，她背叛了咬过她的吸血鬼长老，吸干了他的血，
30ysp-ch5-p008-r02.pinyin: Yībǎi nián qián, tā bèipàn le yǎo guo tā de xīxuèguǐ zhǎnglǎo, xīgān le tā de xuè,

30ysp-ch5-p008-r03.sourceEnglish: And became the hero who brought an end to the vampire rampages scattered across Prizhenkaya.
30ysp-ch5-p008-r03.simplifiedChinese: 并成为终结了普里任卡亚各地吸血鬼暴乱的英雄。
30ysp-ch5-p008-r03.pinyin: Bìng chéngwéi zhōngjié le Pǔlǐrènkǎyà gèdì xīxuèguǐ bàoluàn de yīngxióng.

30ysp-ch5-p008-r04.sourceEnglish: And a vampire who took countless lives under the pretext of "assassination requests."
30ysp-ch5-p008-r04.simplifiedChinese: 也是一个以“暗杀委托”为名夺走无数生命的吸血鬼。
30ysp-ch5-p008-r04.pinyin: Yě shì yī gè yǐ “ànshā wěituō” wéi míng duózǒu wúshù shēngmìng de xīxuèguǐ.

30ysp-ch5-p008-r05.sourceEnglish: And... the shadow blade who devised the extermination unit.
30ysp-ch5-p008-r05.simplifiedChinese: 以及……一手创建讨伐部队的暗影之刃。
30ysp-ch5-p008-r05.pinyin: Yǐjí... yīshǒu chuàngjiàn tǎofá bùduì de ànyǐng zhī rèn.

30ysp-ch5-p010-r06.sourceEnglish: STILL, DON'T GIVE OFF TOO MUCH VENOM.
30ysp-ch5-p010-r06.simplifiedChinese: 不过，别散发出太浓的毒意。
30ysp-ch5-p010-r06.pinyin: Bùguò, bié sànfā chū tài nóng de dúyì.

30ysp-ch5-p014-r06.sourceEnglish: And what's with that beard? Seriously, I'm losing my mind.
30ysp-ch5-p014-r06.simplifiedChinese: 还有那胡子是怎么回事？说真的，我都快疯了。
30ysp-ch5-p014-r06.pinyin: Hái yǒu nà húzi shì zěnme huí shì? Shuō zhēn de, wǒ dōu kuài fēng le.

30ysp-ch5-p015-r03.sourceEnglish: Four years after the Demon King's death, the Kingdom of Krasilof seemed peaceful on the surface,
30ysp-ch5-p015-r03.simplifiedChinese: 魔王死后的第四年，克拉西洛夫王国表面上看似和平，
30ysp-ch5-p015-r03.pinyin: Mówáng sǐ hòu de dì sì nián, Kèlāxīluòfū Wángguó biǎomiàn shàng kàn sì hépíng,

30ysp-ch5-p016-r01.sourceEnglish: The Crown Prince, who is willing to risk even an external war,
30ysp-ch5-p016-r01.simplifiedChinese: 一方是甚至不惜发动对外战争的王储，
30ysp-ch5-p016-r01.pinyin: Yī fāng shì shènzhì bùxī fādòng duìwài zhànzhēng de wángchǔ,

30ysp-ch5-p016-r02.sourceEnglish: And Princess Elizaveta, who seeks to preserve peace from within.
30ysp-ch5-p016-r02.simplifiedChinese: 另一方是试图从内部维护和平的伊丽莎维塔公主。
30ysp-ch5-p016-r02.pinyin: Lìng yī fāng shì shìtú cóng nèibù wéihù hépíng de Yīlìshāwéitǎ Gōngzhǔ.

30ysp-ch5-p016-r04.sourceEnglish: To ensure the key figures entering the academy graduate safely.
30ysp-ch5-p016-r04.simplifiedChinese: 以确保即将进入学院的关键人物能够平安毕业。
30ysp-ch5-p016-r04.pinyin: Yǐ quèbǎo jíjiāng jìnrù xuéyuàn de guānjiàn rénwù nénggòu píng'ān bìyè.

30ysp-ch5-p018-r03.simplifiedChinese: 那个疯子到底在想什么？！
30ysp-ch5-p018-r03.pinyin: Nàge fēngzi dàodǐ zài xiǎng shénme?!

30ysp-ch5-p022-r02.sourceEnglish: But she cherishes me and protects this country. She's a true hero!
30ysp-ch5-p022-r02.simplifiedChinese: 但她珍爱我，也守护着这个国家。她是真正的英雄！
30ysp-ch5-p022-r02.pinyin: Dàn tā zhēn'ài wǒ, yě shǒuhù zhe zhège guójiā. Tā shì zhēnzhèng de yīngxióng!

30ysp-ch5-p022-r04.sourceEnglish: My answer would be "one's humanity," Sir Petrovich!
30ysp-ch5-p022-r04.simplifiedChinese: 我的答案会是“人性”，彼得罗维奇先生！
30ysp-ch5-p022-r04.pinyin: Wǒ de dá'àn huì shì “rénxìng”, Bǐdéluówéiqí Xiānsheng!

30ysp-ch5-p022-r11.sourceEnglish: Don't want to kill you, Nan.

30ysp-ch5-p024-r01.sourceEnglish: Then I, too, will ask you with our memories as collateral.
30ysp-ch5-p024-r01.simplifiedChinese: 那么，我也要押上我们共同的回忆来问你。
30ysp-ch5-p024-r01.pinyin: Nàme, wǒ yě yào yāshàng wǒmen gòngtóng de huíyì lái wèn nǐ.

30ysp-ch5-p024-r02.pinyin: Nǐ de zhōngchéng jiūjìng shǔyú shéi?

30ysp-ch5-p026-r07.sourceEnglish: Either way, the problem is solved.
30ysp-ch5-p026-r07.simplifiedChinese: 不管怎样，问题已经解决了。
30ysp-ch5-p026-r07.pinyin: Bùguǎn zěnyàng, wèntí yǐjīng jiějué le.

30ysp-ch5-p026-r11.sourceEnglish: Master, your bloodlust was intense. I expect nothing less from the former thief of the Hero's Party...!
30ysp-ch5-p026-r11.simplifiedChinese: 师父，您刚才的杀气真重。不愧是勇者小队的前盗贼……！
30ysp-ch5-p026-r11.pinyin: Shīfu, nín gāngcái de shāqì zhēn zhòng. Bùkuì shì yǒngzhě xiǎoduì de qián dàozéi...!

30ysp-ch5-p027-r02.sourceEnglish: But Ivan, why on earth did you teach the orphans ambush techniques?
30ysp-ch5-p027-r02.simplifiedChinese: 不过，伊凡，你到底为什么要教孤儿们伏击术？
30ysp-ch5-p027-r02.pinyin: Bùguò, Yīfán, nǐ dàodǐ wèishénme yào jiāo gū'érmen fújī shù?

30ysp-ch5-p028-r04.sourceEnglish: Which means this place is quite far from the orphanage.
30ysp-ch5-p028-r04.simplifiedChinese: 也就是说，这里离孤儿院相当远。
30ysp-ch5-p028-r04.pinyin: Yě jiùshì shuō, zhèlǐ lí gū'éryuàn xiāngdāng yuǎn.

30ysp-ch5-p028-r05.sourceEnglish: Why did Priscilla come all the way out here in the first place?
30ysp-ch5-p028-r05.simplifiedChinese: 普里西拉一开始为什么要大老远跑到这里来？
30ysp-ch5-p028-r05.pinyin: Pǔlǐxīlā yī kāishǐ wèishénme yào dàlǎoyuǎn pǎo dào zhèlǐ lái?

30ysp-ch5-p029-r01.sourceEnglish: Is that why she thought I was going to leave?
30ysp-ch5-p029-r01.simplifiedChinese: 她是因为这个才以为我要离开吗？
30ysp-ch5-p029-r01.pinyin: Tā shì yīnwèi zhège cái yǐwéi wǒ yào líkāi ma?

30ysp-ch5-p030-r00.sourceEnglish: Perhaps the children simply noticed what was in my heart.
30ysp-ch5-p030-r00.simplifiedChinese: 也许孩子们只是察觉到了我心里的念头。
30ysp-ch5-p030-r00.pinyin: Yěxǔ háizimen zhǐshì chájué dào le wǒ xīnlǐ de niàntou.

30ysp-ch5-p032-r11.sourceEnglish: Since next year's entrance exam is this coming November...
30ysp-ch5-p032-r11.simplifiedChinese: 既然明年的入学考试就在今年十一月……
30ysp-ch5-p032-r11.pinyin: Jìrán míngnián de rùxué kǎoshì jiù zài jīnnián shíyī yuè...

30ysp-ch5-p033-r00.sourceEnglish: That means we can see him in one year.
30ysp-ch5-p033-r00.simplifiedChinese: 也就是说，一年后我们就能见到他了。
30ysp-ch5-p033-r00.pinyin: Yě jiùshì shuō, yī nián hòu wǒmen jiù néng jiàn dào tā le.

30ysp-ch5-p034-r02.simplifiedChinese: 瓦西里萨孤儿院的每个孩子……
30ysp-ch5-p034-r02.pinyin: Wǎxīlǐsà Gū'éryuàn de měi gè háizi...

30ysp-ch5-p034-r03.sourceEnglish: ...has begun preparing for admission to St. Jansk University!!
30ysp-ch5-p034-r03.simplifiedChinese: ……都开始为考入圣扬斯克大学做准备了！！
30ysp-ch5-p034-r03.pinyin: ...dōu kāishǐ wèi kǎorù Shèng Yángsīkè Dàxué zuò zhǔnbèi le!!

30ysp-ch5-p034-r08.sourceEnglish: Daughter of Einar, the Berserker of the Hero's Party.
30ysp-ch5-p034-r08.simplifiedChinese: 勇者小队狂战士埃纳尔的女儿。
30ysp-ch5-p034-r08.pinyin: Yǒngzhě xiǎoduì kuángzhànshì Āinà'ěr de nǚ'ér.
